verdict: Zomato's refund and payment complaints are a visible gap, but Swiggy's own late-delivery and support problems must be fixed before any comparison campaign.
topOpportunity: Refunds that arrive without a fight: 15% of Zomato's specific 1–2★ complaints are about payments & refunds, vs 5% of yours.
topThreat: Rival's delivery reliability is also under pressure: 40% of your specific 1–2★ complaints are about delivery & fulfilment (late, cancelled, missing, no-show), vs 27.5% of Zomato's.
